services.name: Boat rental
services.desc: Boats are equipped with safety package, life jackets, fenders, fire extinguisher, anchor. Gas: Boats are filled up with gas and must be full upon return, or filled at Mary Lake Marina to avoid charge. 1 day rentals on Mary Lake will be charged in full at time of reservation. In case of cancellations, the charge is NON-REFUNDABLE within 14 days of the rental starting date. Multiple day reservations require a credit card on file 1 month before the rental start date to hold the reservation. In case of cancellations, 25% is NON-REFUNDABLE within 14 days of the rental start

variants.label: Rental boats including Glastron, Tahoe, Pontoon boats and Lund Fishing boats

blurb: Mary Lake Marina offers a variety of rental boats for guests to experience boating on Mary Lake without owning a boat. The business is family-run and aims to provide exceptional service and a friendly atmosphere. They are located 5 minutes south of Huntsville, Ontario.
